correctness.rationale: For fixed r>0 and gamma>0, L(x^2+gamma q^2)=4-r x^2-2(x-q)^2 gives coercive recurrence; direct stationarity equations give uniform second moments. The compensated-reset martingale identity shows that the integrated tracer differs from the instantaneous bath average by O_L2(gamma^-1/2) on compact rescaled times. Stationarity then forces the bath marginal to converge to the unique Gaussian invariant of an explicitly derived OU diffusion. Disintegration of any tight joint invariant subsequential limit identifies the exact conditional reset-OU law. The empirical-average regimes follow from this Gaussian OU limit, an L2 bath increment estimate and an exact positive integrated stationary autocovariance. value.rationale: The result rigorously justifies a physically motivated quasi-static bath approximation and identifies the observable time needed for a long tracer trajectory to self-average: sub-bath windows retain a Gaussian random offset, comparable windows have the explicit strict crossover Phi, and super-bath windows average to zero. This is an interpretable structural classification of incomplete environmental equilibration, not a mere re-evaluation of a known variance.
